endpoints.summary: Log in a customer with email and password
endpoints.description: Authenticates an existing credentials auth identity and returns a JWT for the customer actor. Concrete instance of the core route POST /auth/{actor_type}/{auth_provider} with actor_type=customer and auth_provider=credentials. No store API key is required on /auth routes and no bearer token is needed. The request body is not validated by a zod schema: unknown fields are ignored; the credentials provider only checks that `email` and `password` are strings. Every authentication failure (missing/non-string password or email, unknown email, wrong password) returns 401 with type "unauthorized". The returned token is signed with the project's JWT secret and expires after jwtExpiresIn (default "1d"; this repository does not override it). If the auth identity has not yet been linked to a customer (registered via /auth/customer/credentials/register but POST /store/customers was never called), the call still succeeds with 200, but the token carries an empty actor_id: it is accepted by POST /store/customers but rejected with 401 by /store/customers/me. Password verification runs scrypt (N=2^15, r=8, p=1) on the libuv threadpool, so this endpoint is CPU/memory heavy compared to other store calls; an unknown email returns without running scrypt.

email.description: Email the credentials identity was registered with (the identity's entity_id). Matched exactly.

password.description: Plain-text password; verified against the stored scrypt hash.

token.description: Signed JWT (HS256 with the project's jwtSecret unless jwtOptions override it).

responses.description: Authenticated. Body carries the JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on /store/* calls. The token payload contains actor_id (the customer id, or "" when the identity has no customer yet), actor_type "customer", auth_identity_id, auth_provider "credentials", app_metadata and user_metadata. Expires after 1 day by default (jwtExpiresIn "1d"). The `location` (OAuth redirect) and `mfa_required` / `verification_required` variants of this route are not reachable for credentials with this repository's configuration (no MFA factors, no authVerificationsPerActor).

The customer actor is not allowed to use the credentials provider (only when projectConfig.http.authMethodsPerActor.customer is configured without "credentials"; not the case in this repository, whose config sets no authMethodsPerActor for customer).

message.description: Known literals: "Invalid email or password", "Password should be a string", "Email should be a string".

responses.description: Authentication failed. Unknown email or wrong password → "Invalid email or password" (same message for both). Missing or non-string `password` → "Password should be a string" (checked first); missing or non-string `email` → "Email should be a string". Any other provider error is also returned here with its own message.

endpoints.summary: Register a customer email/password auth identity
endpoints.description: Creates an auth identity for the `customer` actor with the `credentials` provider and returns a registration JWT. This does NOT create a customer: the returned token has an empty `actor_id` and is only accepted by `POST /store/customers` (which runs authenticate with allowUnregistered), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` together with the store key. After the customer is created, obtain a customer token with `POST /auth/customer/credentials` (login), because this registration token keeps `actor_id` empty. No store key is required on /auth routes. The body is not validated by zod: unknown fields are ignored. The password is hashed with scrypt (logN 15, r 8, p 1, about 32 MiB of memory per hash, runs in the libuv thread pool), so each call is CPU and memory heavy. `email` is stored as-is (no lower-casing, no format check here) and must be unique per call: a load-test feeder must supply a fresh email for every iteration (e.g. a unique suffix per virtual user and iteration such as `perf+<vu>-<iter>@example.com`).

email.description: Identifier of the auth identity (stored as provider identity entity_id, unique per provider). Must be a non-empty string. Must be unique per call; take it from a feeder that yields a fresh address each iteration (shape: local-part@domain).

password.description: Plain password; must be a non-empty string. Hashed with scrypt before storage.

responses.description: Auth identity created (or an existing identity with no app_metadata and a matching password was found). Returns a registration JWT whose actor_id is empty (payload: actor_id "", actor_type "customer", auth_identity_id, auth_provider "credentials"); default expiry 1d. Use it only for POST /store/customers.

The customer actor type is restricted by projectConfig.http.authMethodsPerActor and credentials is not in its allowlist (not the case with the default config used by this project: only `user` gets a default allowlist).

message.description: One of "Identity with email already exists", "Password should be a string", "Email should be a string", or an internal error message.

responses.description: Registration failed. Triggers: an auth identity with this email already exists and either already has app_metadata (a customer was created for it) or the password does not match -> "Identity with email already exists"; missing or non-string password -> "Password should be a string" (checked first); missing or non-string email -> "Email should be a string"; a concurrent register with the same email can hit the unique index on (entity_id, provider) and returns 401 with the database error message.

endpoints.description: Creates a cart and returns it with the default store cart fields. The work is finished when the 200 arrives (synchronous createCartWorkflow; only the cart.created event is async). Sales channel: if sales_channel_id is omitted/null and the store key has exactly one sales channel, that channel is used; a key with several channels requires sales_channel_id; a sales_channel_id not linked to the key is rejected (400, body {errors, message}). A key with no channels falls back to the store's default_sales_channel_id. Region: region_id omitted/null uses the store's default region; the seed never sets default_region_id, so the undefined filter is dropped and the first region (seed: only "Europe", eur) is used. Customer: a valid customer bearer token attaches that customer (customer_id = token actor_id; email defaults to the customer's email); without a token, a given email attaches a registered customer with that email, or reuses/creates a guest customer. Items are priced in the region currency and stock-checked against stock locations linked to the cart's sales channel; product-to-sales-channel membership is NOT checked. No payment collection and no shipping methods are created here. The returned cart.id is the {id} for all /store/carts/{id}/... operations.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fields of the returned cart. Prefix with + to add to or - to remove from the defaults; without a prefix it replaces the defaults. Allowed: the default fields plus allowedStoreCartExtraFields (e.g. items.total, payment_collection.status).

schema_def.description: All fields optional. Strict: any key not listed here is rejected with 400 "Invalid request: Unrecognized fields: '<key>'".

region_id.description: Region id. Omitted/null: the store's default_region_id is looked up; the seed never sets it, so the region filter is undefined and dropped, and the first region found (seed: the only region "Europe", eur) is used. Unknown id: 404 "No regions found" (or a pricing error first if items are sent without currency_code).

email.description: Cart email. When given, a customer is looked up by email: a registered customer (has_account) is attached as is; otherwise an existing guest customer is reused or a new guest customer is created and attached (cart.customer gets an id).

currency_code.description: Optional; defaults to the region currency. If given it must equal the region currency (case-insensitive), else 400 "Currency code <x> does not match the region's currency code <y>".

sales_channel_id.description: Optional. Omitted/null: taken from the store key when the key has exactly one sales channel (seed: Default Sales Channel); a key with several channels makes it mandatory. A value not linked to the key: 400.

items.description: Initial line items, priced in the region currency.

variant_id.description: Product variant id. Must exist, belong to a published product, have a price in the region currency and have stock in a stock location linked to the cart's sales channel (when inventory is managed).

shipping_address.description: Strict: unknown keys are rejected. The field may instead be a string (id of an existing address); that variant is not modelled here.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lower case; must belong to the cart's region for later shipping steps.

billing_address.description: Strict: unknown keys are rejected. The field may instead be a string (id of an existing address); that variant is not modelled here.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lower case; must belong to the cart's region for later shipping steps.

promo_codes.description: Promotion codes to apply. Any code that does not exist: 400 "The promotion code <code> is invalid" and the cart is rolled back.

locale.description: Locale used to translate line item titles.

additional_data.description: Free-form data passed to workflow hooks (WithAdditionalData). The repository registers no hooks.

empty_body_default_region.summary: No region_id: falls back to the first region (seed: Europe/eur) and the key's sales channel (200)

guest_email.summary: Guest email: a guest customer is found or created and attached (200)

explicit_sales_channel.summary: Explicit sales_channel_id linked to the key (200; mandatory when the key has several channels)

sales_channel_not_in_key.summary: sales_channel_id not linked to the store key (400, errors[] body)

unknown_region.summary: Unknown region_id without items (404 No regions found)

currency_mismatch.summary: currency_code differs from the region currency (400)

unknown_variant.summary: Variant does not exist or its product is not published (400)

variant_without_price.summary: Variant has no price in the region currency (400)

out_of_stock.summary: Quantity above available stock (seed stock 1000000) (400 insufficient_inventory)

invalid_promo_code.summary: Unknown promotion code (400; cart creation rolled back)

unknown_field.summary: Unknown top-level key rejected by the strict validator (400)

request_body.description: JSON body; may be empty ({}). Body fields select the branches listed in examples.

cart.description: Trimmed: the real body carries every field of defaultStoreCartFields (all total/subtotal/tax/discount breakdowns, promotions, shipping_methods, region.countries, payment_collection, credit_lines...).

items.description: Empty when no items were sent.

variant.description: Variant snapshot (nested product data); not expanded.

customer.description: Set when a customer token was sent or an email was given (guest customer); otherwise null/absent.

payment_collection.description: Not created by this operation (null/absent); created later by POST /store/payment-collections.

responses.description: Cart created. The real body carries more fields than modelled (all totals breakdowns, region countries, promotions...).

schema_def.description: Validation/workflow errors: {code?, type, message}. Sales-channel middleware errors instead: {errors: [string], message: "Provided request body contains errors. Please check the data and retry the request"} with no type.

code.description: "insufficient_inventory" for the stock failure; absent otherwise.

errors.description: Only for the store-key / sales-channel mismatch errors.

responses.description: Bad request. Triggers: missing/invalid x-store-api-key (type not_allowed); body validation ("Invalid request: ...": unknown key, quantity <= 0, missing variant_id, invalid email); sales_channel_id not linked to the key (errors[]: "Sales channel ID in payload <id> is not associated with the store API Key in the header."); key with several sales channels and no sales_channel_id (errors[]: "Cannot assign sales channel to cart. The store API Key in the header has multiple associated sales channels. Please provide a sales channel ID in the request body."); disabled sales channel ("Unable to assign cart to disabled Sales Channel: <name>"); currency_code differs from region currency ("Currency code <x> does not match the region's currency code <y>"); unknown variant / unpublished product ("Variants <ids> do not exist or belong to a product that is not published"); variant without price in the currency ("Variants with IDs <ids> do not have a price"); items sent with an unknown region_id and no currency_code ("Method calculatePrices requires currency_code in the pricing context"); sales channel without stock location for a managed variant ("Sales channel <id> is not associated with any stock location for variant <id>."); insufficient stock (code insufficient_inventory, type not_allowed, "Some variant does not have the required inventory"); unknown promotion code ("The promotion code <code> is invalid").
region_id does not match any region ("No regions found"); also when the store has no region at all, or a sales_channel_id/customer id cannot be found.

endpoints.description: Reads the cart through remote query (refetchCart). No customer check, no sales-channel check, no completed-cart guard: open and completed carts are both returned with 200 (completed_at distinguishes them).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated field selection. Prefix '+' adds to the default fields, '-' removes, a plain list replaces the defaults. Fields outside the allowed list are stripped silently.

cart.description: Trimmed: the real body also carries all original_*/item_*/shipping_*/credit_line_* totals, promotions, items[].tax_lines/adjustments/product, shipping_methods[].tax_lines/adjustments, billing_address, region.countries, customer, credit_lines, metadata, locale.

completed_at.description: null while the cart is open; set once POST /store/carts/{id}/complete created an order. A completed cart is still returned with 200.

id.description: Not in the default cart fields: returned only when the request adds ?fields=+shipping_methods.id (the query layer prunes nested relations to the requested fields). No Store route consumes it.

shipping_address.description: id, first_name, last_name, company, address_1, address_2, city, postal_code, country_code, region_code, province, phone.

responses.description: The cart. The real body carries more fields than listed (all totals, promotions, tax lines, adjustments, billing address, customer, region countries).
Missing x-store-api-key header (shown) or unknown/revoked key (message "A valid store key is required to proceed with the request").
